snippet.title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon -  Unprecedented Mission
snippet.description:
Experience the continuation of the expansive Calvard arc when Trails beyond the Horizon launches on January 15, 2026 for Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PS4, PS5, and PC! 

Van Arkride and the members of Arkride Solutions are back, and this time the future of the entire Zemurian continent is at stake! The people of Zemuria await the launch of humanity’s first foray into space with bated breath. A sudden invitation from Marduk to cooperate in a high-tech training exercise sets Van Arkride, Ashen Chevalier Rean Schwarzer, and Father Kevin Graham on a collision course with the secrets at the very core of Zemuria.

Their paths may diverge, but the ultimate question remains the same: Just what lies beyond the edge of the horizon? 

Follow @NISAmerica on X, Instagram, and Facebook for updates! 
Preorder now @ thelegendofheroes.com/horizon/

#TrailsbeyondtheHorizon
